shortBio.en: The voice of Zeppelin's myth—and a solo career that refused to freeze in 1971.
shortBio.zh: Zeppelin 神话的嗓音——以及拒绝冻结在 1971 的独奏生涯。

whyHub.en: Frontman as evolving person: arena howl, then restless reinvention beyond the classic lineup.
whyHub.zh: 主唱作为会进化的人：体育馆嘶吼之后，在经典阵容之外持续再发明。

body.en: Plant is the human face of lineup mythology: the Classic IV is sacred, but the person keeps moving. Use this page to exit the band bubble into post-Zeppelin listening without erasing the peak version.
body.zh: Plant 是阵容神话的人脸：经典四人组神圣，但人继续走。用此页离开乐队气泡，走进后 Zeppelin 听法，同时不抹掉巅峰版本。
